samples.summary: Header/footer runs are the one canvas path left painting per-run highlight rects, so the issue-#1036 symptom survives there for justified text
samples.evidence: `renderHeaderFooterBlocks` still loops `for (const run of line.runs) this.renderRunWithPageNumber(...)`, and `renderRunWithPageNumber` (doc-canvas.ts:721) passes `skipBackground: false`. The new `drawInlineRunBackgroundsForLine` docstring (paint-layout.ts:210-213) advertises itself as "the single source of inline-highlight geometry for every call site (docs body pages, slides / board text boxes, table cells)" but header/footer is not among them. The both-edges rounding added in `renderRun` (paint-layout.ts:489) removes the sub-pixel seam there, but the second failure mode the change names — `applyAlignment('justify')` shifting `run.x` without growing `run.width` — is only fixed by band coalescing, so a justified highlighted header/footer line keeps real multi-pixel gaps between words while the identical body paragraph one inch below renders as a solid band. Whether the issue's acceptance covers header/footer text is not stated in the material I was given, hence medium confidence.

samples.summary: PDF export keeps its own per-segment background rectangles, so exported output now diverges from the on-screen band geometry
samples.evidence: `pdf-painter.ts:758-767` draws `page.drawRectangle` per measured segment with `segWidthPt`, independent of the new coalescing helper. After this change the canvas paints one band per contiguous same-colour stretch (bridging justify slack), while a PDF export of the same document paints one rect per word and leaves the justify gaps unfilled — two answers to "where is the highlight" for the same document. The cost is confined to export fidelity (no seam, since PDF uses exact float widths), so minor rather than major; a follow-up is arguably fine, but nothing in the diff records the divergence.

samples.summary: New docstring lists call sites that do not exist (board text boxes) and omits ones that do (header/footer)
samples.evidence: paint-layout.ts:212-213 claims the helper is the single geometry source for "docs body pages, slides / board text boxes, table cells". `packages/board/src/**` contains no reference to `paintLayout`, `drawText` from the slides text renderer, or `@wafflebase/docs` rich-text painting, so board is not a call site; conversely the real remaining per-run call site (DocCanvas header/footer) is not mentioned in that list. Documentation-only inaccuracy in a comment that future readers will use to reason about the pipeline.
